summary: String-keyed resource registry lookup-or-create. Copies the filename argument into a stack buffer, transforms it with sub_589901, and strips the file extension by scanning backward for a '.' and null-terminating there. Walks the global registry linked list headed at dword_8B8E20, comparing the stored name (node+20) with the stripped string; the next-node pointer lives at node+2160. On a match it writes the node into *a1 (when a1 is non-null) and returns 0. On no match it allocates a 2164-byte entry via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and initializes it with HashTable; if sub_552470(a2, a3) reports registration failure (non-zero) the entry is cleaned up with EmptyStub_7470 and FreeWrapper_7bcf and -1 is returned; otherwise the entry is appended via LinkedListAppend_d340, written to *a1, and 0 is returned.

local_names.a1: optional output pointer for the found/allocated registry entry
local_names.a2: input filename (copied and stripped of extension before comparison)
local_names.SrcStr: stack buffer holding the transformed, extension-stripped filename
local_names.v4: linked-list walk pointer over the registry

operations.description: strcpy(SrcStr, a2) copies the input filename into the 256-byte stack buffer.
sub_589901(SrcStr) transforms the buffer before comparison.
Extension strip: scan backward from strlen(SrcStr)-1 while the byte is not '.' (0x2E); when found, truncate at that position; scan only while the index stays above 0.
Walk the registry from the global head dword_8B8E20 while strcmp(node+20, SrcStr) is non-zero, advancing through the next-node pointer at node+2160; loop guard requires a non-null head.
On a name match, write the found node into *a1 when a1 is non-null.
On no match, OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(2164) allocates a new registry entry.
HashTable(v5) initializes the new entry's internal table when allocation succeeded.
sub_552470(a2, a3) == 0 selects the registration-success path; a non-zero result selects the failure/cleanup path.
On registration success, LinkedListAppend_d340(entry) appends it to the registry and the entry is written into *a1 when a1 is non-null.
On registration failure, EmptyStub_7470(entry) then FreeWrapper_7bcf(entry) clean up the allocated entry.
Return 0 on found or appended entries, -1 when registration failed. Used by collision node allocation, cockpit gauge setup and scene-file parsing paths.
